edges.reason: msg.sender flows into _transfer through _msgSender() as the token sender and sniper-check subject.
setmaxTX authorizes msg.sender against owner() or marketingAddress before changing maxTX.
ManualswapTokens transfers the full contract token balance to _msgSender().
addBlacklist is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner.
initContract sets Limtcheck[_msgSender()] = true, whitelisting the caller.
removeBlacklist is guarded by onlyOwner.
changeSellTx is guarded by onlyOwner.
setFeeRate is guarded by onlyOwner.
setMarketingAddress is guarded by onlyOwner.
ManualApproval is guarded by onlyOwner and approves router spending.
openTrading records launchTime = block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp == launchTime is used for sniper detection inside _transfer (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline (timestamp dependency).
_transfer calls swapTokens when selling and the contract holds tokens.
swapTokens forwards the token balance to swapTokensForEth.
swapTokens sends the resulting ETH balance to the fee address.
lockTheSwap toggles inSwapAndLiquify as the swap reentrancy guard.
_transfer delegates balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
Standard transfer branch when neither party is excluded.
Branch when the recipient is excluded from rewards.
Branch when the sender is excluded from rewards.
Branch when both parties are excluded from rewards.
_transferStandard routes the liquidity share through _takeLiquidity.
_transferStandard routes the reflection fee through _reflectFee.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds tFee to _tFeeTotal.
_takeLiquidity credits rLiquidity to _rOwned[address(this)].
_transferStandard updates sender and recipient _rOwned balances.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap swap while token accounting is mid-flight.
addLiquidity performs an external value-bearing addLiquidityETH call.
sendETHToFee transfers the ETH balance to marketingAddress.
transferToAddressETH performs recipient.transfer(amount).
ManualApproval approves the router to spend the contract token balance.
initContract assigns the hardcoded router to uniswapV2Router.
initContract creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
initContract whitelists the caller, router, pair and marketing address in Limtcheck.
The constructor calls openTrading() to enable trading at deployment.
The constructor mints the full _rTotal to _msgSender() in _rOwned.
openTrading sets tradingOpen = true.
openTrading stores block.timestamp into launchTime.
openTrading sets the liquidity fee.
openTrading sets the reflection tax fee.
setmaxTX writes the new transfer limit into maxTX.
setMarketingAddress updates the ETH fee recipient.
addBlacklist sets _isSniper[account] = true.
removeBlacklist clears _isSniper[account].
setFeeRate updates the swap cap rate.
changeSellTx toggles the opensellTx sell gate.
_transfer reads opensellTx and reverts sells when disabled.
_transfer consults the Limtcheck whitelist before enforcing maxTX.
_transfer enforces the maxTX limit on transfers.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect swaps.
_transfer checks _isSniper for both recipient and caller.
_transfer requires tradingOpen for pair buys and swaps.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
_transfer compares to against uniswapV2Router to exclude router transfers.
deliver subtracts rAmount from the caller's _rOwned balance.
deliver reduces _rTotal by rAmount.
excludeFromReward sets _isExcluded[account] = true.
includeInReward clears _isExcluded[account].
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership zeroes out _owner.
The external Uniswap swap can call back into _transfer before token balances are finalized.
ETH pushed to marketingAddress during a transfer can re-enter the transfer flow.
recipient.transfer can re-enter transferToAddressETH during ETH delivery.
